scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,cyan "npm run dev -w @airp/server" "npm run dev -w @airp/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @airp/shared && npm run build -w @airp/server && npm run build -w @airp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @airp/shared && npm run typecheck -w @airp/server && npm run typecheck -w @airp/web
